name: Pit-Hag
ability: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not-in-play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
interaction: Chooses a player and a character. If the character is not in play, the chosen player wakes and is shown YOU ARE + their new character; the Pit-Hag is told nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: No transformation happens (the Pit-Hag is still woken to choose, but nothing changes).

jinxes.text: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Politician, they can't turn good due to their own ability.

rulings.text: If the chosen character is already in play, nothing happens.
Alignment does not change: an evil player made a Townsfolk stays evil, a good player made a Minion or Demon stays good.
If a Demon is created, the Storyteller chooses that night's deaths (counted as Pit-Hag attacks).
Turning a Demon into another Demon usually means no deaths, or the old Demon dies alongside another player.

test_scenarios.name: basic transform
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pit-Hag, Bob Clockmaker, Carol Imp; Mutant not in play.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob as Mutant.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob wakes, shown YOU ARE Mutant; Bob is Mutant, still good.

test_scenarios.name: character in play
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pit-Hag, Bob Savant, Dave Sage.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob as Sage.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing changes; Bob is not woken.

test_scenarios.name: demon made
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pit-Hag, Bob Oracle (good), Carol Imp; No Dashii not in play.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Alice chooses Bob as No Dashii.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob becomes a good No Dashii; the Storyteller decides tonight's deaths arbitrarily.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pit-Hag poisoned by Erin Poisoner, Bob Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob as Drunk.

test_scenarios.name: damsel jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pit-Hag, Bob Chef; Damsel not in play.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob as Damsel.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller chooses which player becomes the Damsel (may be someone other than Bob).
